label: Range: recovery entry, with the below-sale re-entry limit (exploratory)
status: planned practice run (PLAN-DRAFT.md v0.5 section 6; the owner's decisions D1-D8, EXPERIMENT-LOG.md entry 7); experimental settings, not the owner's trading
notes: D1: no stock is ever retired; with reentryLimit a signal whose decision close is at or above the last sale price P is refused (skip reentry_limit) and a fill at or above P is cancelled; without it P is only reported. D2: a recovery entry needs an up close and no top-zone close since the bottom visit. D3: after a confirming close (a confirmed breakdown, a breakout, a range trade's breakdown exit or conversion) the range is qualified again only on a window of 60 closes entirely after it, so the earliest entry is the stock's 61st close after it. D4: benchmark (a) is an equal-weight fractional buy-and-hold index, never rebalanced. The pullback watch ends when its entry fills. Two closes for breakdown and for the trend exit is a provisional test assumption (owner decision 3). Decisions after the close with next-open fills do not reproduce the owner's intraday reactions (decision 6). Results apply only to HXR's ten hand-picked stocks (decision 10).
